rows.behavior: Every front matter key in the repository's own .okf/ is in ALLOWED_FIELDS (I4), so decision_status and decided_on are gone.
rows.fails_when: any page under .okf/ has a front matter key, nested keys as paths, that ALLOWED_FIELDS lacks

rows.behavior: Every decision record has a Consequences heading, its own or inside an appended Correction section, and the log names every record touched.
rows.fails_when: a file in .okf/decisions/ other than index.md has no Consequences heading, or .okf/log.md has no line naming one of the nine records

rows.behavior: The briefing names every skill folder the packaged plugin ships (ADR 0002), read at run time.
rows.fails_when: kmctl briefing's output lacks the name of a folder under the plugin payload's skills/, including a skill folder the test adds to a copy

rows.behavior: The briefing stays inside the I3 word budget, and the bundle passes the okf validator in strict mode.
rows.fails_when: the existing budget test fails, or okf_validate --strict reports a problem on .okf/

rows.behavior: The supersede module's docstring no longer names decision_status, and supersede still writes only spec fields.
rows.fails_when: src/kmctl/supersede.py mentions decision_status, or tests/test_supersede.py fails
